body:
SPEC CORRECTION FROM EXECUTABLE PROTOTYPE — profile request is not profile certification.

The draft said every manifest contains the local-open profile. The partial-delivery law also says a
valid semantic model plus failed preview.html lowering remains an auditable bundle. Those two claims
cannot both mean certification: the old shape would label the failed bundle local-open even though
the obvious preview does not exist.

CORRECTION: the base local-open profile is always REQUESTED and has exactly one typed outcome:
Satisfied(certificationReceipt), Failed(error, receipt), or NotAttempted(reason, receipt?). The
network-independent profile uses the same outcome family and is Satisfied only after its stronger
courts pass. profileOutcomes replaces a bare profiles list in story-output-manifest/v1.

Binding laws: satisfied local-open requires a produced browser_preview; failed/not-attempted
browser_preview cannot coexist with satisfied local-open; HTML failure leaves canonical.txt,
storymodel.json, result.json, other reports, and manifest intact while both the HTML role and
local-open profile are failed. This keeps A5 partial delivery without manufacturing conformance.

The isolated c8ffe86 prototype caught this because BundleManifest could not honestly validate the
HTML-failure fixture under its previous always-local-open rule. After the correction: acquire JVM
92/92, view JVM 52/52, codec JVM 112/112. This is evidence for the spec ruling, not a repository
candidate or implementation authority.
